product.name: Monoprice 15-in-1 Triple-Display MST Docking Station
product.description: Monoprice™Universal USB‑C Docking Station15‑in‑1 All‑in‑One USB‑C Dock with Multiple Display Modes in a Small Package, Ready to Work Wherever You AreThe Monoprice 15-in-1 Triple-Display MST Docking Station revolutionizes the way you work by transforming your laptop or PC into a comprehensive workstation with remarkable versatility. With a single USB-C® (with DisplayPort™ Alt Modes) or Thunderbolt® port, this docking station provides an array of features that enhance productivity and connectivity without compromising on convenience.Equipped with four 4K video outputs, including two HDMI ports and two DisplayPort™ ports, the Monoprice docking station empowers you to connect up to three external displays simultaneously. Whether you prefer HDMI®, DP, or a combination of both, the choice is yours. Immerse yourself in the brilliance of high-resolution visuals and experience an expansive workspace that boosts multitasking capabilities to new heights.In addition to its impressive display capabilities, the docking station boasts an assortment of connectivity options to accommodate your various devices and peripherals. With three USB-C ports offering lightning-fast 10Gbps data transfer speeds, you can effortlessly connect your smartphones, tablets, or other compatible devices. Furthermore, one of these USB-C ports supports 30W PD downstream charging, ensuring that your mobile devices stay powered up throughout the day.The docking station also features three USB-A ports, each operating at 10Gbps (USB 3.2 Gen 2), facilitating rapid file transfers and accommodating additional peripherals such as mice, keyboards, headphones, or external storage devices. Seamlessly move large files in a matter of seconds and optimize your workflow with ease.No workstation is complete without efficient card reading capabilities. The Monoprice docking station includes SD® and MicroSD® card slots, utilizing the SD4.0 standard at a blazingly fast 312MBps. Transfer files effortlessly between your workstation and memory cards, facilitating seamless data management.Moreover, the docking station provides a Gigabit Ethernet port, ensuring reliable and speedy wired network connectivity. Stay connected to the internet with stable and consistent speeds, enabling uninterrupted work, seamless streaming, or lag-free online gaming.With a distributed power supply of 150W, the docking station ensures that all your connected devices receive the necessary power. This intelligent power allocation includes a maximum of 96W dedicated to host charging, allowing you to keep your laptop or PC powered up while utilizing all the docking station's features.The Monoprice docking station boasts plug-and-play convenience, eliminating the need for complex installations or configurations. Simply connect your laptop or PC via USB-C or Thunderbolt, and you're ready to unleash the full potential of your workstation. Compatible with Windows®, MacOS®, and Thunderbolt, this docking station seamlessly integrates with various operating systems, ensuring broad compatibility and hassle-free usage across different devices.In summary, the Monoprice 15-in-1 Triple-Display MST Docking Station redefines what it means to have a complete workstation. From its multiple video outputs and ultra-fast USB ports to its SD/MicroSD card readers, Gigabit Ethernet connectivity, and distributed power supply, this docking station combines functionality and versatility to create a seamless and efficient workspace. Unlock new levels of productivity, immerse yourself in high-resolution visuals, and streamline your workflow with this powerful and innovative docking station.Supports 4x video outputs, 6 ultra‑fast USB ports (10Gbps), SD/MicroSD card readers, Gigabit Ethernet, 3.5mm audio/microphoneSupports up to 3x high‑resolution external displays (any combination of HDMI & DP ports)6x USB3.2 Gen2 ports with 10Gbps transfer speed150W distributed power supply with max 96W for host chargingUSB‑C port provides 30W PD fast charging for phones and tabletsPlug‑and‑playSupports Windows, MacOS, and Thunderbolt MASSIVE EXPANDABILITYFully compatible with your USB-C (DP1.2 & 1.4 Alt Mode) and Thunderbolt laptops and desktops. With one cable connection, add multiple monitors, USB ports, SD/MicroSD card readers, and Ethernet for all your workstation needs. UP TO TRIPLE HIGH‑RESOLUTION EXTERNAL DISPLAYSChoose any triple‑display combination from the 4x video ports (2x HDMI & 2 DP ports). Supports max 4K@60Hz for single‑display, 2x 4K@30Hz for dual‑display, and 4K@30Hz + 1080p@60Hz triple-display. SUPER FAST DATA TRANSFER + HIGH POWER CHARGING3x USB‑A ports with USB3.2 Gen2 10Gbps speed, use them for large file transfer in seconds or simply connect to a mouse, keyboard, headphone, external hard drive, etc. 3x USB‑C ports also with USB3.2 Gen2 10Gbps speed for super fast data transfer. SD4.0 card slot transfers at 312MBps, over 3 times faster than SD3.0. 150W power supply dynamically distributed to power all connected devices, with max 96W for host charging. One USB‑A port supplies 7.5W downstream charging.
